data.title: 春原瞬 · 居室烛光下的深情私语
data.description: 檀香袅袅的静谧卧房，雕花烛台跳跃着暖橙色的微光。瞬被老师轻柔环住腰肢，向来稳重大方的大姐姐教官此刻双颊泛起动人情潮，美眸迷离含水。她微微前倾朱唇凑在老师耳际，呼出的热气带着淡淡梅香，低语着长久以来深埋心底的少女依恋。
data.location: dim oriental master bedroom beside wooden screen
data.action: leaning close, whispering into ear, heavy blush, breathless affection, trembling gaze
data.lighting: intimate warm candlelight flickering with soft shadows
data.mood: deeply passionate vulnerability, intoxicating heat, and romantic surrender
data.promptProse: Bathed in soft candlelight beside an oriental folding screen, Sunohara Shun leans intimately close with heavily flushed cheeks and melting crimson eyes, whispering softly.
data.animaCaption: Shun leaning close with flushed cheeks and melting affectionate eyes. Warm candlelight and gentle room light reveal her face and the wooden screen nearby.
